about: Layout of manual-download packs: file names, sizes and one box per frame or tile. Read by tools/art/placeholders.py.

packs.name: 2D Top-Down Pixel Art Tileset: Casino
packs.author: Jephed (Game Between The Lines)
packs.license: custom: free for commercial and non-commercial use, credit requested ('Jephed, Game Between The Lines, https://gamebetweenthelines.com/'); silent on redistribution
packs.drop: Download the free zip from the page, extract it, and copy `2D_TopDown_Tileset_Casino_1024x512.png`, `2D_TopDown_Tileset_Casino_640x512.png` and the whole `Animated Sprite Sheets/` folder into this folder, replacing the stand-ins.

packs.name: The Dark Ritual starter pack
packs.author: BigWander
packs.license: custom: free incl. commercial use, modification allowed, credit requested; no resale or redistribution, even modified
packs.drop: Download the free zip, extract it, and copy its `Spritesheet/` and `IndividualSprites/` folders here.

packs.name: 32x32 slot machine
packs.author: Kia
packs.license: free for non-commercial games (custom); commercial use: pay what you think is fair; no redistribution grant
packs.drop: Download `slot.png` from the page and put it here.

packs.name: Free Pixel VFX Pack - 35 Animated Effects (20 used)
packs.author: NogitsuneGurl
packs.license: custom: free in free or commercial games, editing allowed; no resale or redistribution as a standalone pack; credit appreciated
packs.drop: Download the free zip and copy the effect folders from its `Effects/` folder here (for example `Effects/Coin-Sparkle/` becomes `Coin-Sparkle/`). Each brings its `_sheet.png`, `game/` strip and real `anchor.json`; the other 15 effects can come along.

packs.name: Super Pixel Effects Gigapack (Free Version) v3.1.0 (14 effects used)
packs.author: Will Tice / unTied Games
packs.license: custom unTied Games license (http://untiedgames.com/files/license.txt): commercial and non-commercial use OK, attribution required, no redistribution of the pack except inside a game, no AI training
packs.drop: Download the free zip and copy its `spritesheet/` folder here (paths look like `spritesheet/Magic Bursts/directional_coin_burst_001/directional_coin_burst_001_small_yellow/spritesheet.png`). The `.txt` frame maps come with it.

packs.name: Free Effect and Bullet 16x16
packs.author: BDragon1727
packs.license: free for non-commercial games (custom); commercial use needs a contribution of any amount; modify OK; no resale or redistribution
packs.drop: Download the four sheets from the page and put them here with their original names.

packs.name: Holy Spell Effect + Dark Spell Effect (free VFX 01-02)
packs.author: pimen
packs.license: custom: free for personal and commercial use and modification; no resale or redistribution; credit appreciated
packs.drop: Download the free files from https://pimen.itch.io/holy-spell-effect and https://pimen.itch.io/dark-spell-effect, extract the .rar archives, and copy the sheets so the paths match: `holy/Holy VFX 01/...`, `holy/Holy VFX 02/...`, `dark/Dark VFX 1/...`, `dark/Dark VFX 2/...`.

packs.name: 16x16 Free NPC Pack + Enchanted Forest Characters (0x72 extensions)
packs.author: Superdark
packs.license: custom informal grant: free for any use incl. commercial, modification OK, no credit needed (author answered 'Yes it is' to 'Is it CC0?' in the Enchanted Forest comments); kept out of the repo because there is no formal CC0 deed
packs.drop: Download the NPC pack and https://superdark.itch.io/enchanted-forest-characters, put `Fantasy RPG NPCs - Characters.png` and `Enchanted Forest Characters with animations.png` here. The NPC pack's animated frames come as a .rar; extract it here too if wanted.

packs.name: m6x11, m6x11plus and m3x6 pixel fonts
packs.author: Daniel Linssen (managore)
packs.license: custom: free to use with attribution ('Font by Daniel Linssen'); no license file, no redistribution grant
packs.drop: Download m6x11 (and m6x11plus) from https://managore.itch.io/m6x11 and m3x6 from https://managore.itch.io/m3x6 and put the .ttf files here. Until then each name is a copy of the CC0 m5x7.
